about_the_game:
"Wuxing Summoner" is a game that combines match-three with turn-based strategy! Here, you match elements to gather resources, summon soldiers, and battle on a turn-based battlefield.

Players need to match elements on the three-match board on the left side of the screen to use the soldier cards to summon soldiers to fight against enemies. Each round, there are three opportunities to move the pieces on the board. After completing the actions, click the end turn button, and it will enter turn-based combat to fight with the enemies. If the enemies reach the main character's vehicle or leave the battlefield, they will inflict damage on the main character. If the battle is won, the remaining health of the soldiers will be restored to the main character.

Core gameplay features: 

  • Strategic elimination: control the battlefield: On the left side of the battlefield is a match-3 board. Every clever elimination you make is crucial! Match 5 different attributes to summon soldiers. Your matching strategy will directly determine the outcome of the battlefield on the right.

  • Assemble a legion and strategize: From high-damage axe soldiers to long-range archers, from strong defensive sword and shield soldiers to balanced spear soldiers, recruit an army. Based on the enemy's weaknesses, arrange your lineup and develop strategies to defeat them.

  • Turn-based combat: Command your army to clash with enemies on the turn-based battlefield on the right. Seize the opportunity to strike, focus fire on high-threat targets; every movement and every attack requires careful thought.

Match, summon, conquer!

The game is in early version, and more content will be updated later.

No story mode available

No music available
